title: Add Internet Identity login UI

requirements.text: Add a login/logout control to the site header using the existing Internet Identity provider so visitors can sign in and sign out without usernames/passwords.
acceptanceCriteria: When the user is not authenticated, the header shows a clearly labeled "Sign in" button.
Clicking "Sign in" triggers Internet Identity login via the existing `useInternetIdentity()` hook (no automatic login on page load).
While login is in progress, the sign-in button shows a loading state and is disabled to prevent duplicate attempts.
When the user is authenticated, the header shows the signed-in state (at minimum a "Sign out" button; optionally show a short/abbreviated principal).
Clicking "Sign out" logs the user out via the existing `clear()` function from `useInternetIdentity()` and returns the header to the signed-out state.
If a login error occurs, an understandable English error message is shown in the UI (inline near the auth control or as a dismissible alert).

requirements.text: Ensure the mobile navigation experience also exposes the same sign-in/sign-out functionality so authentication is available on small screens.
acceptanceCriteria: On mobile (sheet menu open), the user can sign in when signed out and sign out when signed in.
Auth controls in the mobile menu reflect the same loading and error states as the desktop header auth control.
Signing in/out updates the UI state correctly without requiring a manual refresh.

constraints: Do not edit files under `frontend/src/components/ui` (compose existing components instead).
Do not edit immutable hook paths: `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/main.tsx`.
Authentication must use Internet Identity only (no username/password system).
Respect the existing single-page app routing and layout structure.
nonGoals: Building a custom username/password database or admin user management.
Adding role-based authorization or protected pages (unless separately requested).
